inv.desc_es:
Atención Inversores;

Retail vende local dividido en 8 locales comerciales en rentabilidad al 4,36% anual sitos en la calle Bravo Murillo haciendo esquina con las calles Pensamiento y Lérida y a pocos metros de la calle Sor Ángela de la Cruz, en pleno distrito de Tetuán. Zona muy comercial de Madrid con gran tránsito peatonal y tráfico rodado.

Características:

- Superficie: 1.434, 68 m² en total, divididos en 719,50 m² en planta calle y 715,8 m² en planta sótano.

- Fachada total haciendo esquina de 26 + 21,9 + 23 metros lineales.

- Altura de 3 metros.

- Salida de humos: NO.

- Rentabilidad: 4,36%.

Llámenos para concertar una entrevista de inversión en nuestras oficinas y le ampliaremos la información.

inv.desc_en:
Attention Investors;

Retail sells a commercial space divided into 8 commercial units with an annual profitability of 4.36%, located on Bravo Murillo street, corner of Pensamiento and Lérida streets, and a few meters from Sor Ángela de la Cruz street, in the heart of the Tetuán district. Very commercial area of Madrid with high pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

Characteristics:

- Surface area: 1,434. 68 m² in total, divided into 719.50 m² on the ground floor and 715.8 m² in the basement.

- Total corner facade of 26 + 21.9 + 23 linear meters.

- Height of 3 meters.

- Smoke outlet: NO.

- Profitability: 4.36%.

Call us to arrange an investment meeting at our offices and we will provide you with more information.

- Key Tenants: OH! MY BARBER, CAIXA BANK, ALAIN AFFLELOU OPTICIAN, QUICK GOLD, MANIK TRAVEL, FINETWORK, SAYLU COSMETICS, LITTLE CAESARS PIZZA, TATATELECOM, HUMANA, MI ALCAMPO, PRIMAPRIX, PAN DELIRIO, PALOMERO DRIVING SCHOOL, BIT BASE, EMPANADAS MALVÓN, ETC.

Retail, a leading specialist in commercial properties, business expansion, and investment, with over 2,300 successful operations in our 22 years of experience in the real estate market. We have more properties available on the most commercial streets throughout Spain.
